title: Reduce Senior dev quest reward to 1 Pollen
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Changes new Senior dev rewards from 2 to 1 Pollen; previously recorded rewards keep their amounts.
- Updates the quest expectations and a stale leaderboard render test for the current component.

gist.headline: A smaller Senior dev seed
gist.blurb: The Senior dev quest gets a 1-Pollen reward for new completions. Earlier rewards keep their recorded amounts.
gist.summary: The Senior dev quest changes its reward from 2 to 1 Pollen for new completions, while preserving previously recorded reward amounts.
gist.impact: New Senior dev completions earn 1 Pollen; completed rewards retain the amounts recorded when they were earned.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Senior dev quest as a garden task card beside a single Pollen token, with an older completed card safely tucked into a ledger. Polli, wearing tiny reading glasses, checks the ledger; flowers and code-plants keep the scene warm and grounded.
